items.title: Apple’s CEO Calls Memory Pricing “Unprecedented.” Its Purchase Obligations Jumped $33 Billion in a Quarter
items.summary: Key TakeawaysApple CEO John Ternus called memory pricing “unprecedented” and said Apple’s manufacturing purchase obligations rose $33 billion from June to September. Memory costs look set to weigh on Apple’s gross margin into fiscal 2027, and its price increases only partly offset them.

items.title: Warning for CoreWeave: Satya Nadella Says “Selling to One or Two Customers Is Not a Business”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysMicrosoft CEO Satya Nadella said selling to one or two customers “is not a business,” and that Microsoft builds its own capacity first and rents last. That’s a warning for CoreWeave, whose three biggest customers made up 72% of second-quarter revenue, and for Nebius and IREN, which count Microsoft as an anchor customer.

items.title: KEPCO Confirms Major Data Breach Affecting 1.52 Million Users
items.summary: Korea Electric Power Corporation (KEPCO) reported a significant data breach involving the personal information of approximately 1.52 million users across its customer service and procurement systems.
items.content: On November 22, 2026, KEPCO announced that an external attacker accessed and stole personal data from two of its internal systems. The breach affected 650,487 users of the KEPCO ON customer service platform and 869,761 users of the electronic procurement system (SRM). Compromised information includes names, resident registration numbers, bank account details, credit card records, and billing data for customers, as well as contact details for corporate representatives and company employees. Upon discovering the incident, KEPCO suspended the affected services and blocked external access to its systems. The company has launched an investigation in coordination with the National Intelligence Service and other government agencies to determine the cause and prevent further damage. KEPCO President and CEO Kim Dong-cheol issued an apology and committed to improving the company's information security infrastructure.
